defmodule FileProcessor.SessionManager do
  use GenServer

  @session_ttl 3600
  @circuit_breaker_threshold 5
  @circuit_breaker_reset 30_000

  defstruct sessions: %{}, circuit: :closed, failure_count: 0, last_failure: nil

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %__MODULE__{}, opts)
  end

  def init(state) do
    schedule_cleanup()
    {:ok, state}
  end

  def authenticate(pid, credentials) do
    GenServer.call(pid, {:authenticate, credentials})
  end

  def process_file(pid, session_id, file_path) do
    GenServer.call(pid, {:process_file, session_id, file_path})
  end

  def get_session(pid, session_id) do
    GenServer.call(pid, {:get_session, session_id})
  end

  def handle_call({:authenticate, %{username: username, password: password, session_id: provided_sid}}, _from, state) do
    case state.circuit do
      :open ->
        if System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) - state.last_failure > @circuit_breaker_reset do
          handle_auth_attempt(username, password, provided_sid, %{state | circuit: :half_open})
        else
          {:reply, {:error, :circuit_open}, state}
        end
      _ ->
        handle_auth_attempt(username, password, provided_sid, state)
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:authenticate, %{username: username, password: password}}, _from, state) do
    case state.circuit do
      :open ->
        if System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) - state.last_failure > @circuit_breaker_reset do
          handle_auth_attempt(username, password, nil, %{state | circuit: :half_open})
        else
          {:reply, {:error, :circuit_open}, state}
        end
      _ ->
        handle_auth_attempt(username, password, nil, state)
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:process_file, session_id, file_path}, _from, state) do
    case Map.get(state.sessions, session_id) do
      nil ->
        {:reply, {:error, :invalid_session}, state}
      session ->
        if session.authenticated do
          safe_path = sanitize_path(file_path)
          result = do_process_file(safe_path, session)
          {:reply, result, state}
        else
          {:reply, {:error, :not_authenticated}, state}
        end
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:get_session, session_id}, _from, state) do
    {:reply, Map.get(state.sessions, session_id), state}
  end

  def handle_info(:cleanup, state) do
    now = System.system_time(:second)
    cleaned = state.sessions
    |> Enum.reject(fn {_id, s} -> now - s.created_at > @session_ttl end)
    |> Map.new()
    schedule_cleanup()
    {:noreply, %{state | sessions: cleaned}}
  end

  defp handle_auth_attempt(username, password, provided_sid, state) do
    case verify_credentials(username, password) do
      {:ok, user_data} ->
        session_id = resolve_session_id(provided_sid)
        session = %{
          id: session_id,
          user: user_data,
          authenticated: true,
          created_at: System.system_time(:second),
          permissions: user_data.permissions
        }
        new_state = %{state |
          sessions: Map.put(state.sessions, session_id, session),
          circuit: :closed,
          failure_count: 0
        }
        {:reply, {:ok, session_id}, new_state}
      {:error, _reason} ->
        new_count = state.failure_count + 1
        new_circuit = if new_count >= @circuit_breaker_threshold, do: :open, else: state.circuit
        new_state = %{state |
          failure_count: new_count,
          circuit: new_circuit,
          last_failure: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
        }
        {:reply, {:error, :invalid_credentials}, new_state}
    end
  end

  defp resolve_session_id(nil), do: generate_session_id()
  defp resolve_session_id(provided) when is_binary(provided) and byte_size(provided) > 0 do
    provided
  end
  defp resolve_session_id(_), do: generate_session_id()

  defp generate_session_id do
    :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32) |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false)
  end

  defp verify_credentials(username, password) do
    stored = get_stored_credentials(username)
    case stored do
      nil -> {:error, :not_found}
      %{hash: hash, user_data: user_data} ->
        if Bcrypt.verify_pass(password, hash) do
          {:ok, user_data}
        else
          {:error, :invalid_password}
        end
    end
  end

  defp get_stored_credentials(username) do
    # Simulated credential store lookup
    case username do
      "admin" -> %{hash: Bcrypt.hash_pwd_salt("secret"), user_data: %{name: "admin", permissions: [:read, :write, :admin]}}
      "user" -> %{hash: Bcrypt.hash_pwd_salt("password"), user_data: %{name: "user", permissions: [:read]}}
      _ -> nil
    end
  end

  defp sanitize_path(path) do
    path
    |> Path.expand()
    |> then(fn expanded ->
      base_dir = Application.get_env(:file_processor, :base_dir, "/var/data/uploads")
      if String.starts_with?(expanded, base_dir) do
        expanded
      else
        raise "Path traversal attempt detected"
      end
    end)
  end

  defp do_process_file(path, session) do
    if :read in session.permissions do
      case File.read(path) do
        {:ok, content} -> {:ok, process_content(content)}
        {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
      end
    else
      {:error, :insufficient_permissions}
    end
  end

  defp process_content(content) do
    content
    |> String.split("\n")
    |> Enum.map(&String.trim/1)
    |> Enum.reject(&(&1 == ""))
    |> length()
  end

  defp schedule_cleanup do
    Process.send_after(self(), :cleanup, 60_000)
  end
end
